daas-irab:1-1.t: ﴿يا أَيُّهَا﴾ yā is a vocative particle, and the one addressed (munādā), an intended indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma; hā is for drawing attention (tanbīh). ﴿النَّبِيُّ﴾ badal (substitute); the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya) and has no grammatical position. ﴿اتَّقِ اللَّهَ﴾ An imperative verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), and the Divine Name is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is likewise initial and has no grammatical position. ﴿وَلا تُطِعِ﴾ The wāw is a conjunction, and an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the prohibitive lā, and the fāʿil is latent. ﴿الْكافِرِينَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَالْمُنافِقِينَ﴾ Conjoined to الكافرين; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ﴾ inna, and the Divine Name is its ism. ﴿كانَ﴾ A defective (nāqiṣ) past verb whose ism is latent. ﴿عَلِيماً حَكِيماً﴾ Two khabars (predicates) of kāna; the verbal clause is the khabar of inna. And the nominal clause is a causation (taʿlīl) and has no grammatical position.

daas-irab:10-10.t: ﴿إِذْ﴾ badal (substitute) for the preceding one. ﴿جاؤُكُمْ﴾ A past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl (object); the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation. ﴿مِنْ فَوْقِكُمْ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿وَمِنْ أَسْفَلَ﴾ [A preposition and its genitive noun] conjoined to what precedes them. ﴿مِنْكُمْ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أسفل. ﴿وَإِذْ﴾ Conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿زاغَتِ الْأَبْصارُ﴾ A past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation. ﴿وَبَلَغَتِ الْقُلُوبُ﴾ A past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿الْحَناجِرَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَتَظُنُّونَ﴾ An imperfect verb and its fāʿil. ﴿بِاللَّهِ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿الظُّنُونَا﴾ mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object); the clause is conjoined to what precedes it.

daas-irab:11-11.t: ﴿هُنالِكَ﴾ A demonstrative in the position of accusative as an adverb of time (ẓarf zamān). ﴿ابْتُلِيَ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ﴾ A passive past verb and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position. ﴿وَزُلْزِلُوا﴾ A passive past verb, and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil. ﴿زِلْزالًا﴾ mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿شَدِيداً﴾ An adjective (ṣifa); the clause is conjoined to what precedes it.

daas-irab:12-12.t: ﴿وَإِذْ﴾ The wāw is a conjunction. ﴿إِذْ﴾ Conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿يَقُولُ الْمُنافِقُونَ﴾ An imperfect verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation. ﴿وَالَّذِينَ﴾ Conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿فِي قُلُوبِهِمْ﴾ khabar (predicate) placed first. ﴿مَرَضٌ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject) placed after; the nominal clause is the ṣila (relative clause) and has no grammatical position. ﴿ما﴾ negating. ﴿وَعَدَنَا اللَّهُ﴾ A past verb and its mafʿūl (object), and the Divine Name is the fāʿil. ﴿وَرَسُولُهُ﴾ Conjoined to the Divine Name. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ A particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿غُرُوراً﴾ Second mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).

daas-irab:2-2.t: ﴿وَاتَّبِعْ﴾ An imperative verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿ما﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿يُوحى﴾ A passive imperfect verb, and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is latent; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of ما. ﴿إِلَيْكَ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿مِنْ رَبِّكَ﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ﴾ inna, and the Divine Name is its ism. ﴿كانَ﴾ A defective (nāqiṣ) past verb whose ism is latent. ﴿بِما﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to خبيرا. ﴿تَعْمَلُونَ﴾ An imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila of ما. ﴿خَبِيراً﴾ The khabar (predicate) of kāna; the clause كان.. is the khabar of inna, and the clause إن الله.. is a causation (taʿlīl) and has no grammatical position.

daas-irab:3-3.t: ﴿وَتَوَكَّلْ﴾ An imperative verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿عَلَى اللَّهِ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَكَفى﴾ The wāw is a resumptive particle, and a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the alif. ﴿بِاللَّهِ﴾ The bāʾ is a redundant (zāʾida) preposition, and the Divine Name is genitive (majrūr) in form, nominative (marfūʿ) in position, the fāʿil of كفى. ﴿وَكِيلًا﴾ tamyīz (specification). The clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position.

daas-irab:4-4.t:
﴿ما﴾ negating. ﴿جَعَلَ اللَّهُ﴾ A past verb, and the Divine Name is its fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position. ﴿لِرَجُلٍ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿مِنْ﴾ A redundant (zāʾida) preposition. ﴿قَلْبَيْنِ﴾ genitive (majrūr) in form, accusative (manṣūb) in position, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿فِي جَوْفِهِ﴾ An adjective (ṣifa) of قلبين. ﴿وَما﴾ The wāw is a conjunction. ﴿ما﴾ negating. ﴿جَعَلَ﴾ A past verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿أَزْواجَكُمُ﴾ First mafʿūl bihi. ﴿اللَّائِي﴾ An adjective of أزواجكم. ﴿تُظاهِرُونَ﴾ An imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿مِنْهُنَّ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿أُمَّهاتِكُمْ﴾ Second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَما جَعَلَ﴾ Conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿أَدْعِياءَكُمْ﴾ First mafʿūl bihi. ﴿أَبْناءَكُمْ﴾ Second mafʿūl bihi.
﴿ذلِكُمْ قَوْلُكُمْ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject) and its khabar (predicate); the clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position. ﴿بِأَفْواهِكُمْ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَاللَّهُ يَقُولُ﴾ The wāw is a resumptive particle, the Divine Name is a mubtadaʾ, and an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿الْحَقَّ﴾ mafʿūl bihi; the verbal clause is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ, and the nominal clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position. ﴿وَ﴾ The wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya). ﴿هُوَ﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿يَهْدِي﴾ An imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿السَّبِيلَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi; the verbal clause is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ, and the nominal clause is a ḥāl.

daas-irab:5-5.t: ﴿ادْعُوهُمْ﴾ An imperative verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl (object). ﴿لِآبائِهِمْ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; the clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position. ﴿هُوَ أَقْسَطُ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject) and its khabar (predicate); the clause is a causation (taʿlīl) and has no grammatical position. ﴿عِنْدَ اللَّهِ﴾ An adverb of place annexed to the Divine Name. ﴿فَإِنْ﴾ The fāʾ is a resumptive particle. ﴿إن﴾ A jussive conditional particle. ﴿لَمْ تَعْلَمُوا﴾ An imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by lam, and the wāw is its fāʿil. ﴿آباءَهُمْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya) and has no grammatical position. ﴿فَإِخْوانُكُمْ﴾ The fāʾ is connective (rābiṭa). ﴿إخوانكم﴾ khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ; the clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). ﴿فِي الدِّينِ﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَمَوالِيكُمْ﴾ Conjoined to إخوانكم. ﴿وَلَيْسَ﴾ The wāw is a resumptive particle. ﴿لَيْسَ﴾ A defective (nāqiṣ) past verb. ﴿عَلَيْكُمْ﴾ The khabar of laysa, placed first. ﴿جُناحٌ﴾ Its ism, placed after; the clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position. ﴿فِيما﴾ An adjective (ṣifa) of جناح. ﴿أَخْطَأْتُمْ﴾ A past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿بِهِ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿وَلكِنْ﴾ The wāw is a conjunction. ﴿لكِنْ﴾ A particle of rectification (istidrāk). ﴿ما﴾ Conjoined to فيما. ﴿تَعَمَّدَتْ قُلُوبُكُمْ﴾ A past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿وَكانَ﴾ The wāw is a resumptive particle. ﴿كانَ اللَّهُ غَفُوراً رَحِيماً﴾ kāna, its ism and its two khabars; the clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position.

daas-irab:6-6.t:
﴿النَّبِيُّ أَوْلى﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject) and its khabar (predicate); the clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position. ﴿بِالْمُؤْمِنِينَ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) أولى. ﴿مِنْ أَنْفُسِهِمْ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أولى as well. ﴿وَأَزْواجُهُ أُمَّهاتُهُمْ﴾ mubtadaʾ and its khabar; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَ﴾ The wāw is a conjunction. ﴿أُولُوا الْأَرْحامِ﴾ mubtadaʾ, annexed to الأرحام. ﴿بَعْضُهُمْ أَوْلى﴾ mubtadaʾ and its khabar; the nominal clause is the khabar of أولو, and the clause أولو.. is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿بِبَعْضٍ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أولى. ﴿فِي كِتابِ اللَّهِ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أولى as well, and the Divine Name is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أولى. ﴿وَالْمُهاجِرِينَ﴾ Conjoined to المؤمنين.
﴿إِلَّا﴾ A particle of exception. ﴿أَنْ تَفْعَلُوا﴾ An imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an, and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent); the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) formed from an and the verb is accusative as the excepted (manṣūb ʿalā al-istithnāʾ). ﴿إِلى أَوْلِيائِكُمْ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿مَعْرُوفاً﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿كانَ ذلِكَ﴾ kāna and its ism. ﴿فِي الْكِتابِ مَسْطُوراً﴾ [في الكتاب is] a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the khabar مسطورا; the clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position.

daas-irab:7-7.t: ﴿وَإِذْ﴾ The wāw is a resumptive particle. ﴿إِذْ﴾ An adverb of time. ﴿أَخَذْنا﴾ A past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation. ﴿مِنَ النَّبِيِّينَ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿مِيثاقَهُمْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿وَمِنْكَ﴾ [A preposition and its genitive noun] conjoined to what precedes them. ﴿وَمِنْ نُوحٍ﴾ [A preposition and its genitive noun] conjoined to what precedes them. ﴿وَإِبْراهِيمَ وَمُوسى وَعِيسَى﴾ Conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿ابْنِ﴾ An adjective (ṣifa) of عيسى. ﴿مَرْيَمَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَأَخَذْنا﴾ Conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿مِنْهُمْ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿مِيثاقاً﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿غَلِيظاً﴾ An adjective.

daas-irab:8-8.t: ﴿لِيَسْئَلَ﴾ An imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied (muḍmara) an after the lām of causation, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) formed from an and the verb is in the position of genitive by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) أخذنا. ﴿الصَّادِقِينَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿عَنْ صِدْقِهِمْ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿وَأَعَدَّ﴾ The wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿لِلْكافِرِينَ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿عَذاباً﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿أَلِيماً﴾ An adjective (ṣifa); the clause is conjoined to what precedes it.

daas-irab:9-9.t:
﴿يا﴾ A vocative particle. ﴿أَيُّهَا﴾ The one addressed (munādā), an intended indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), and hā is for drawing attention (tanbīh). ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ badal (substitute) for أي. ﴿آمَنُوا﴾ A past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿اذْكُرُوا﴾ An imperative verb and its fāʿil, and ﴿نِعْمَةَ اللَّهِ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object) annexed to the Divine Name. ﴿عَلَيْكُمْ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) نعمة; the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya) and has no grammatical position. ﴿إِذْ﴾ An adverb of time. ﴿جاءَتْكُمْ﴾ A past verb and its mafʿūl. ﴿جُنُودٌ﴾ fāʿil placed after; the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation. ﴿فَأَرْسَلْنا﴾ A past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿عَلَيْهِمْ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿رِيحاً﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَجُنُوداً﴾ Conjoined to ريحا. ﴿لَمْ تَرَوْها﴾ An imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by lam, the wāw is its fāʿil, and hā is the mafʿūl bihi; the clause is an adjective (ṣifa) of جنود. ﴿وَكانَ اللَّهُ﴾ The wāw is a resumptive particle, and kāna, and the Divine Name is its ism. ﴿بِما﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the khabar بصيرا. ﴿تَعْمَلُونَ﴾ An imperfect verb and its fāʿil. ﴿بَصِيراً﴾ khabar (predicate); the clause is the ṣila, and the clause كان الله..
is resumptive and has no grammatical position.

daas-irab:51-51.t: ﴿تُرْجِي﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) with an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the yāʾ owing to heaviness; its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿مَنْ﴾ a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is resumptive. ﴿تَشاءُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿مِنْهُنَّ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَتُؤْوِي﴾ conjoined (maʿṭūf) to تُرْجِي. ﴿إِلَيْكَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to تؤوي. ﴿مَنْ﴾ relative, mafʿūl bihi. ﴿تَشاءُ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative, its fāʿil latent; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَمَنِ﴾ relative, mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause is conjoined. ﴿ابْتَغَيْتَ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿مِمَّنْ﴾ مِن a preposition and مَن relative; the two are attached to the verb after them. ﴿عَزَلْتَ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, latent [Translator's note: so in the source; the fāʿil here is the overt tāʾ of عَزَلْتَ]. ﴿فَلا﴾ the fāʾ is connective (rābiṭa) and لا is the lā of generic negation. ﴿جُناحَ﴾ the noun of لا, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa. ﴿عَلَيْكَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar (predicate) of لا; the clause is the khabar of مَن ابتغيت. ﴿ذلِكَ﴾ ذا a demonstrative in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ; the lām is for distance and the kāf for address. ﴿أَدْنى﴾ khabar, nominative with an implied ḍamma on the alif owing to impossibility; the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَنْ﴾ a subjunctive particle (nāṣiba). ﴿تَقَرَّ﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb). ﴿أَعْيُنُهُنَّ﴾ fāʿil, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); أن and what follows it is accusative by removal of the preposition (manṣūb bi-nazʿ al-khāfiḍ), and the two are attached to أدنى, the implied form being «بأن تقرّ». ﴿وَلا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and لا is prohibitive. ﴿يَحْزَنَّ﴾ an imperfect verb, indeclinable on the sukūn, conjoined. ﴿وَيَرْضَيْنَ﴾ an imperfect verb, indeclinable on the sukūn because it is attached to the nūn of the feminine plural; the nūn is its fāʿil and the clause is conjoined. ﴿بِما﴾ the bāʾ is a preposition and ما is relative; the two are attached to يرضين. ﴿آتَيْتَهُنَّ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi; the nūn is for the feminine; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿كُلُّهُنَّ﴾ tawkīd (emphasis) for the fāʿil of يرضين. ﴿وَاللَّهُ﴾ the Divine Name, mubtadaʾ; the clause is conjoined. ﴿يَعْلَمُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is the khabar. ﴿ما﴾ a relative noun in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi of يعلم. ﴿فِي قُلُوبِكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ṣila. ﴿وَكانَ اللَّهُ عَلِيماً حَلِيماً﴾ كان, its noun and its two predicates.

daas-irab:52-52.t: ﴿لا﴾ negative. ﴿يَحِلُّ لَكَ النِّساءُ﴾ an imperfect verb, and النساء is its fāʿil (agent); the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb before them. ﴿مِنْ بَعْدُ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَلا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and لا is negative. ﴿أَنْ﴾ a subjunctive particle (nāṣiba). ﴿تَبَدَّلَ﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb), its fāʿil latent (mustatir); the clause is conjoined. Its original form is تتبدّل; its tāʾ was elided for lightness. ﴿بِهِنَّ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to تبدّل. ﴿مِنْ﴾ a redundant (zāʾida) preposition. ﴿أَزْواجٍ﴾ a noun genitive in form and accusative in position, mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of تبدّل. Islam has forbidden the "exchange marriage", which is when the husband says to another: "Take my wife and give me your wife." ﴿وَلَوْ﴾ the wāw is the wāw of the ḥāl, and لو is a non-jussive conditional particle. ﴿أَعْجَبَكَ حُسْنُهُنَّ﴾ a past verb; the kāf is its fronted mafʿūl bihi and حسنهن its postponed fāʿil; the clause is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of exception. ﴿ما﴾ relative, in the position of the accusative as the excepted (mustathnā). ﴿مَلَكَتْ يَمِينُكَ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَكانَ اللَّهُ﴾ كان, and the Divine Name is its noun; the clause is conjoined. ﴿عَلى كُلِّ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the khabar (predicate). ﴿شَيْءٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿رَقِيباً﴾ the accusative khabar of كان.

daas-irab:53-53.t: ﴿يا﴾ a vocative particle. ﴿أَيُّهَا﴾ the one addressed (munādā), a specific indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), in the position of the accusative by the vocative; the hāʾ is for alerting (tanbīh). ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ a relative noun in the position of the nominative as badal (substitute) of أيها; the clause is resumptive. ﴿آمَنُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿لا﴾ prohibitive. ﴿تَدْخُلُوا﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لا, the sign of its jussive being the elision of the nūn; the wāw is its fāʿil. ﴿بُيُوتَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿النَّبِيِّ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿أَنْ﴾ a subjunctive particle (nāṣiba). ﴿يُؤْذَنَ﴾ a passive imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb); its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿لَكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb before them. ﴿إِلى طَعامٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb before them. ﴿غَيْرَ﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿ناظِرِينَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr) with the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural. ﴿إِناهُ﴾ mafʿūl bihi of ناظرين. ﴿وَلكِنْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and لكن is a particle of rectification (istidrāk). ﴿إِذا﴾ an adverb containing the sense of a condition. ﴿دُعِيتُمْ﴾ a passive past verb, and the tāʾ is the nāʾib fāʿil; the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فَادْخُلُوا﴾ the fāʾ is connective for the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and an imperative verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the apodosis of إذا. ﴿فَإِذا﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction and إذا is a non-jussive conditional. ﴿طَعِمْتُمْ﴾ a past verb, and the tāʾ is its fāʿil; the clause is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فَانْتَشِرُوا﴾ the fāʾ is connective for the apodosis, and an imperative verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the elision of the nūn; the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is the apodosis of إذا. ﴿وَلا مُسْتَأْنِسِينَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, لا is negative, and مستأنسين is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes it. ﴿لِحَدِيثٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to مستأنسين. ﴿أَنْ﴾ a particle resembling the verb (one of inna and its sisters) [Translator's note: so in the source; the Quranic text here is إِنَّ]. ﴿ذلِكُمْ﴾ the demonstrative, in the position of the accusative as the noun of إنّ; the lām is for distance and the kāf for address. ﴿كانَ﴾ a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb whose noun is omitted; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of إنّ. ﴿يُؤْذِي النَّبِيَّ﴾ an imperfect verb and its mafʿūl bihi; the fāʿil is omitted [Translator's note: so in the source; i.e., a latent pronoun]. ﴿فَيَسْتَحْيِي﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) with an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the yāʾ owing to heaviness; the fāʿil is latent; the clause is conjoined. ﴿مِنْكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb before them. ﴿وَاللَّهُ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya) and the Divine Name is mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause is a ḥāl. ﴿لا﴾ negative. ﴿يَسْتَحْيِي﴾ an imperfect verb; the clause is the khabar. ﴿مِنَ الْحَقِّ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿وَإِذا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and إذا is an adverb of time. ﴿سَأَلْتُمُوهُنَّ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its first mafʿūl bihi; the wāw is for lengthening (ishbāʿ) and the nūn is for the feminine. ﴿مَتاعاً﴾ second mafʿūl bihi; the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فَسْئَلُوهُنَّ﴾ the fāʾ is connective for the apodosis, and an imperative verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the apodosis of إذا, with no grammatical position. ﴿مِنْ وَراءِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the preceding verb. ﴿حِجابٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿ذلِكُمْ﴾ the demonstrative, mubtadaʾ. ﴿أَطْهَرُ﴾ khabar; the clause is resumptive. ﴿لِقُلُوبِكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أطهر. ﴿وَقُلُوبِهِنَّ﴾ conjoined to قلوبكم. ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is resumptive and ما is negative. ﴿كانَ﴾ a defective past verb. ﴿لَكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the fronted khabar of كان; the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَنْ﴾ a subjunctive particle. ﴿تُؤْذُوا﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative, the sign of its accusative being the elision of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil; أن and what follows it are construed as an interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun), the postponed noun of إنّ [Translator's note: so in the source; it is the noun of كان]. ﴿رَسُولَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ the Divine Name, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَلا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and لا is negative. ﴿أَنْ تَنْكِحُوا﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative by أن, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿أَزْواجَهُ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿مِنْ بَعْدِهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl. ﴿أَبَداً﴾ an adverb of time. ﴿أَنْ﴾ a particle resembling the verb [Translator's note: so in the source; the Quranic text here is إِنَّ]. ﴿ذلِكُمْ﴾ the demonstrative, in the position of the accusative as the noun of إنّ; the clause is causal (taʿlīliyya). ﴿كانَ﴾ a past verb whose noun is omitted; the clause is the khabar of إنّ. ﴿عِنْدَ﴾ an adverb, attached to an omitted ḥāl. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ the Divine Name, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿عَظِيماً﴾ the khabar of كان.

daas-irab:54-55.t:
﴿إِنْ﴾ a jussive conditional particle. ﴿تُبْدُوا﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the elision of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya), and it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ). ﴿شَيْئاً﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿أَوْ تُخْفُوهُ﴾ conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes it, and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi. ﴿فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ كانَ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَلِيماً﴾
The fāʾ is connective for the apodosis; إنّ, and the Divine Name is its noun; the clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). The noun of كان is omitted, and عليما is its khabar (predicate); بكل, a preposition and its genitive noun, is attached to (mutaʿalliq) it, and شيء is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿لا﴾ the lā of generic negation. ﴿جُناحَ﴾ the noun of لا, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa. ﴿عَلَيْهِنَّ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar of لا. ﴿فِي آبائِهِنَّ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَلا أَبْنائِهِنَّ وَلا إِخْوانِهِنَّ ... وَلا نِسائِهِنَّ﴾ conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَلا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and لا is negative. ﴿ما﴾ relative, conjoined. ﴿مَلَكَتْ أَيْمانُهُنَّ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَاتَّقِينَ اللَّهَ﴾ an imperative verb, indeclinable on the sukūn because it is attached to the nūn of the feminine plural; the nūn is the fāʿil and the Divine Name is its mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined. ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ كانَ عَلى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ شَهِيداً﴾ its i'rab is like the i'rab of «إن الله كان بكل شيء عليما» above.

daas-irab:56-58.t: ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ﴾ إنّ, and the Divine Name is its noun. ﴿وَمَلائِكَتَهُ﴾ conjoined (maʿṭūf), and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿يُصَلُّونَ﴾ the clause is the khabar (predicate) of إنّ. ﴿عَلَى النَّبِيِّ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) يصلون. ﴿يا﴾ a vocative particle. ﴿أَيُّهَا﴾ the one addressed (munādā), indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, in the position of the accusative; the hāʾ is for alerting (tanbīh). ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ badal (substitute). ﴿آمَنُوا﴾ the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿صَلُّوا﴾ an imperative verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿عَلَيْهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to صلّوا. ﴿وَسَلِّمُوا﴾ conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿تَسْلِيماً﴾ mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿إِنَّ الَّذِينَ﴾ إنّ, and the relative noun is its noun. ﴿يُؤْذُونَ اللَّهَ﴾ an imperfect verb; the wāw is its fāʿil and the Divine Name its mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿وَرَسُولَهُ﴾ conjoined; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿لَعَنَهُمُ اللَّهُ﴾ a past verb; the hāʾ is its mafʿūl bihi and the Divine Name its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar. ﴿فِي الدُّنْيا﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to لعنهم. ﴿وَالْآخِرَةِ﴾ conjoined to what precedes. ﴿وَأَعَدَّ لَهُمْ عَذاباً﴾ a past verb and its mafʿūl bihi, its fāʿil latent (mustatir); the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to أعدّ. ﴿مُهِيناً﴾ naʿt (adjective). ﴿وَالَّذِينَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and the relative noun is mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause is conjoined. ﴿يُؤْذُونَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is its fāʿil and المؤمنين its mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿وَالْمُؤْمِناتِ﴾ conjoined. ﴿بِغَيْرِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb before them. ﴿مَا﴾ the relative noun, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿اكْتَسَبُوا﴾ the clause is the ṣila. ﴿فَقَدِ﴾ the fāʾ is connective (rābiṭa) and قد is a particle of verification (taḥqīq). ﴿احْتَمَلُوا بُهْتاناً﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the khabar of الذين. ﴿وَإِثْماً﴾ conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿مُبِيناً﴾ naʿt.

daas-irab:13-13.t:
﴿وَإِذْ﴾ The wāw is a conjunction. ﴿إِذْ﴾ An adverb. ﴿قالَتْ طائِفَةٌ﴾ A past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation.
﴿مِنْهُمْ﴾ An adjective (ṣifa) of طائفة. ﴿يا أَهْلَ﴾ The one addressed (munādā), annexed (muḍāf). ﴿يَثْرِبَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the vocative clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿لا﴾ The lā of generic negation. ﴿مُقامَ﴾ Its ism, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa. ﴿لَكُمْ﴾ Its khabar (predicate); the nominal clause is likewise the object of the saying. ﴿فَارْجِعُوا﴾ The fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa, and an imperative verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the apodosis of an implied condition and has no grammatical position. ﴿وَيَسْتَأْذِنُ﴾ The wāw is a conjunction. ﴿وَيَسْتَأْذِنُ فَرِيقٌ﴾ An imperfect verb and its fāʿil. ﴿مِنْهُمْ﴾ An adjective of فريق. ﴿النَّبِيَّ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿يَقُولُونَ﴾ An imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿إِنَّ بُيُوتَنا عَوْرَةٌ﴾ inna, its ism and its khabar; the clause is the object of the saying. ﴿وَما﴾ The wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya). ﴿ما﴾ negating, operating like laysa. ﴿هِيَ﴾ Its ism. ﴿بِعَوْرَةٍ﴾ The bāʾ is a redundant (zāʾida) preposition, and عورة is a noun genitive (majrūr) in form, accusative (manṣūb) in position, the khabar of mā; the clause is a ḥāl. ﴿إِنَّ﴾ [Translator's note: so in the source; the word of the verse is إِنْ.] A particle of negation. ﴿يُرِيدُونَ﴾ An imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is its fāʿil. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ A particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿فِراراً﴾ mafʿūl bihi; the clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position.

daas-irab:14-14.t: ﴿وَ﴾ The wāw is a resumptive particle. ﴿لَوْ﴾ A non-jussive conditional. ﴿دُخِلَتْ﴾ A passive past verb, and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿عَلَيْهِمْ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿مِنْ أَقْطارِها﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya) and has no grammatical position. ﴿ثُمَّ﴾ A conjunction. ﴿سُئِلُوا﴾ A passive past verb, and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil. ﴿الْفِتْنَةَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿لَآتَوْها﴾ The lām falls in the apodosis, and a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl; the clause is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition and has no grammatical position. ﴿وَ﴾ The wāw is a conjunction. ﴿ما تَلَبَّثُوا﴾ mā is negating, and a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿بِها﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ A particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿يَسِيراً﴾ An adjective (ṣifa) of a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object).

daas-irab:15-15.t: ﴿وَلَقَدْ﴾ The wāw is a particle of oath and genitive, the lām falls in the answer to the oath, and qad is a particle of verification (taḥqīq). ﴿كانُوا﴾ kāna and its ism. ﴿عاهَدُوا﴾ A past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the khabar (predicate) of kāna. ﴿اللَّهَ﴾ The Divine Name is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿مِنْ قَبْلُ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; and the clause لقد كانوا.. is the answer to the oath and has no grammatical position. ﴿لا﴾ negating. ﴿يُوَلُّونَ﴾ An imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is its fāʿil. ﴿الْأَدْبارَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi; the clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position. ﴿وَكانَ عَهْدُ اللَّهِ﴾ The wāw is a resumptive particle, and kāna and its ism, annexed to the Divine Name. ﴿مَسْؤُلًا﴾ The khabar of kāna; the clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position.

daas-irab:16-16.t: ﴿قُلْ﴾ An imperative verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position. ﴿لَنْ يَنْفَعَكُمُ﴾ An imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by lan, and the kāf is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿الْفِرارُ﴾ fāʿil; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿إِنْ فَرَرْتُمْ﴾ in is a jussive conditional particle, and a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the tāʾ is the fāʿil; the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya) and has no grammatical position. ﴿مِنَ الْمَوْتِ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿أَوِ﴾ A conjunction. ﴿الْقَتْلِ﴾ Conjoined to الموت. ﴿وَ﴾ The wāw is a conjunction. ﴿إِذاً﴾ A particle of answer and recompense (ḥarf jawāb wa-jazāʾ). ﴿لا تُمَتَّعُونَ﴾ [lā is] negating, and a passive imperfect verb, and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ A particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿قَلِيلًا﴾ An adjective (ṣifa) of an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object).

daas-irab:17-17.t: ﴿قُلْ﴾ An imperative verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position. ﴿مَنْ ذَا﴾ man is an interrogative noun, the mubtadaʾ (subject), and the demonstrative is its khabar (predicate); the nominal clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿الَّذِي﴾ badal (substitute) for the demonstrative. ﴿يَعْصِمُكُمْ﴾ An imperfect verb and its mafʿūl (object), and the fāʿil is latent. ﴿مِنَ اللَّهِ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿إِنْ﴾ conditional. ﴿أَرادَ﴾ A past verb in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya) and has no grammatical position. ﴿بِكُمْ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿سُوءاً﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿أَوْ﴾ A conjunction. ﴿أَرادَ بِكُمْ رَحْمَةً﴾ Conjoined to what precedes it. The wāw is a resumptive particle. ﴿وَلا يَجِدُونَ﴾ lā is negating, and an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position. ﴿لَهُمْ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to وليا. ﴿مِنْ دُونِ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to وليا as well. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ The Divine Name is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَلِيًّا﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَلا نَصِيراً﴾ Conjoined to what precedes it.

daas-irab:18-18.t: ﴿قَدْ يَعْلَمُ اللَّهُ﴾ qad is a particle of frequency (taktīr), and an imperfect verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿الْمُعَوِّقِينَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿مِنْكُمْ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) what precedes them; the clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position. ﴿وَالْقائِلِينَ﴾ Conjoined to المعوقين. ﴿لِإِخْوانِهِمْ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to what precedes them. ﴿هَلُمَّ﴾ A verbal noun of command (ism fiʿl amr). ﴿إِلَيْنا﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to what precedes them; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). The wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya). ﴿لا يَأْتُونَ﴾ lā is negating, and an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is its fāʿil. ﴿الْبَأْسَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ A particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿قَلِيلًا﴾ An adjective (ṣifa) of an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object); the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial).

daas-irab:19-19.t:
﴿أَشِحَّةً﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative (manṣūb). ﴿عَلَيْكُمْ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) what precedes them. ﴿فَإِذا﴾ The fāʾ is a resumptive particle. ﴿إذا﴾ A non-jussive conditional adverb (ẓarfiyya sharṭiyya ghayr jāzima). ﴿جاءَ الْخَوْفُ﴾ A past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation. ﴿رَأَيْتَهُمْ﴾ A past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl (object); the clause is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition and has no grammatical position. ﴿يَنْظُرُونَ﴾ An imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is a ḥāl.
﴿إِلَيْكَ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿تَدُورُ أَعْيُنُهُمْ﴾ An imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is a ḥāl. ﴿كَالَّذِي﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿يُغْشى﴾ A passive imperfect verb, and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿عَلَيْهِ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿مِنَ الْمَوْتِ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb as well; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) and has no grammatical position. ﴿فَإِذا﴾ The fāʾ is a resumptive particle. ﴿إذا﴾ A non-jussive conditional adverb. ﴿ذَهَبَ الْخَوْفُ﴾
A past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation. ﴿سَلَقُوكُمْ﴾ A past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl; the clause is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) and has no grammatical position. ﴿بِأَلْسِنَةٍ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿حِدادٍ﴾ An adjective of ألسنة. ﴿أَشِحَّةً﴾ ḥāl, accusative. ﴿عَلَى الْخَيْرِ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to what precedes them. ﴿أُولئِكَ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿لَمْ يُؤْمِنُوا﴾ An imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by lam, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of أولئك, and the clause أولئك.. is resumptive and has no grammatical position. ﴿فَأَحْبَطَ اللَّهُ أَعْمالَهُمْ﴾ The fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb, the Divine Name its fāʿil, and its mafʿūl; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَكانَ﴾ The wāw is a resumptive particle, and a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb. ﴿ذلِكَ﴾ Its ism. ﴿عَلَى اللَّهِ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the khabar ﴿يَسِيراً﴾. The clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position.

daas-irab:20-20.t:
﴿يَحْسَبُونَ﴾ An imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent). ﴿الْأَحْزابَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position. ﴿لَمْ يَذْهَبُوا﴾ An imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by lam, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is the second mafʿūl bihi. The wāw is a resumptive particle. ﴿إِنْ﴾ A jussive conditional particle. ﴿يَأْتِ﴾ An imperfect verb, jussive, the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ). ﴿الْأَحْزابَ﴾ fāʿil; the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya) and has no grammatical position.
﴿يَوَدُّوا﴾ An imperfect verb, jussive because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the apodosis and has no grammatical position. ﴿لَوْ﴾ A maṣdar-forming (maṣdariyya) particle. ﴿أَنَّهُمْ بادُونَ﴾ anna, its ism and its khabar (predicate). ﴿فِي الْأَعْرابِ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) what precedes them; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) formed from law and what follows it is the mafʿūl of يودوا. ﴿يَسْئَلُونَ﴾ An imperfect verb and its fāʿil. ﴿عَنْ أَنْبائِكُمْ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb; the clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position. ﴿وَ﴾ The wāw is a resumptive particle. ﴿لَوْ﴾ A non-jussive conditional. ﴿كانُوا﴾ kāna and its ism. ﴿فِيكُمْ﴾ Its khabar; the clause is initial and has no grammatical position. ﴿ما﴾ negating. ﴿قاتَلُوا﴾ A past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition and has no grammatical position. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ A particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿قَلِيلًا﴾ An adjective (ṣifa) of an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object).

daas-irab:21-21.t: ﴿لَقَدْ﴾ The lām falls in the answer to the omitted oath. ﴿قد﴾ A particle of verification (taḥqīq). ﴿كانَ﴾ A defective (nāqiṣ) past verb. ﴿لَكُمْ﴾ Its khabar (predicate), placed first. ﴿فِي رَسُولِ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ The Divine Name is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿أُسْوَةٌ﴾ The ism of kāna, placed after. ﴿حَسَنَةٌ﴾ An adjective (ṣifa) of أسوة; the clause is the answer to the implied (muqaddar) oath and has no grammatical position. ﴿لِمَنْ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, badal (substitute) for لكم. ﴿كانَ﴾ A defective past verb whose ism is latent (mustatir). ﴿يَرْجُوا﴾ An imperfect verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent; the clause is the khabar of kāna. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ The Divine Name is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and the clause كان.. is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun and has no grammatical position. ﴿وَالْيَوْمَ﴾ Conjoined to the Divine Name. ﴿الْآخِرَ﴾ An adjective of اليوم. ﴿وَذَكَرَ﴾ The wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ The Divine Name is the mafʿūl bihi. ﴿كَثِيراً﴾ An adjective of an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object); the clause is conjoined to what precedes it.

daas-irab:22-22.t: ﴿وَلَمَّا﴾ The wāw is a resumptive particle. ﴿لَمَّا﴾ An adverb of time ("when", ḥīniyya). ﴿رَأَ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ الْأَحْزابَ﴾ [Translator's note: so in the source; the verb in the verse is رَأَى.] A past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl (object); the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation. ﴿قالُوا﴾ A past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the answer of lammā and has no grammatical position. ﴿هذا ما﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject) and its khabar (predicate); the nominal clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿وَعَدَنَا اللَّهُ﴾ A past verb and its mafʿūl, and the Divine Name is the fāʿil placed after; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of ما. ﴿وَرَسُولُهُ﴾ Conjoined to the Divine Name. ﴿وَصَدَقَ اللَّهُ﴾ A past verb, and the Divine Name is its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَرَسُولُهُ﴾ Conjoined to the Divine Name. ﴿وَما﴾ The wāw is a conjunction. ﴿ما﴾ negating. ﴿زادَهُمْ﴾ A past verb and its mafʿūl, and the fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ A particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿إِيماناً﴾ The second mafʿūl of زادهم. ﴿تَسْلِيماً﴾ Conjoined to إيمانا.

daas-irab:23-23.t: ﴿مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ رِجالٌ﴾ A khabar (predicate) placed first and a mubtadaʾ (subject) placed after; the clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position. ﴿صَدَقُوا﴾ A past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is an adjective (ṣifa) of رجال. ﴿ما﴾ maṣdariyya (forming a verbal noun). ﴿عاهَدُوا اللَّهَ﴾ A past verb and its fāʿil, and the Divine Name is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) formed from mā and the verb is the mafʿūl of صدقوا. ﴿عَلَيْهِ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. The fāʾ is a resumptive particle. ﴿فَمِنْهُمْ﴾ khabar placed first. ﴿مِنَ﴾ [Translator's note: the source prints ﴿مِنَ﴾ here; the word of the verse is مَنْ.] mubtadaʾ placed after; the clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position. ﴿قَضى﴾ A past verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿نَحْبَهُ﴾ mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of من. ﴿وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ﴾ A khabar placed first and a mubtadaʾ placed after; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿يَنْتَظِرُ﴾ An imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is the ṣila of من and has no grammatical position. ﴿وَ﴾ The wāw is a conjunction. ﴿ما﴾ negating. ﴿بَدَّلُوا﴾ A past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿تَبْدِيلًا﴾ mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object).

daas-irab:24-24.t: ﴿لِيَجْزِيَ اللَّهُ﴾ An imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied (muḍmara) an after the lām of causation, and the Divine Name is the fāʿil (agent). ﴿الصَّادِقِينَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) formed from the implied an and the verb is in the position of genitive by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted verb. ﴿بِصِدْقِهِمْ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿وَيُعَذِّبَ﴾ Conjoined to يجزي. ﴿الْمُنافِقِينَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿إِنْ﴾ A jussive conditional particle. ﴿شاءَ﴾ A past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, and the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya) and has no grammatical position. ﴿أَوْ﴾ A conjunction. ﴿يَتُوبَ﴾ An imperfect verb conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿عَلَيْهِمْ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يتوب. ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ﴾ inna, and the Divine Name is its ism. ﴿كانَ﴾ A defective (nāqiṣ) past verb whose ism is latent. ﴿غَفُوراً رَحِيماً﴾ Two khabars (predicates) of kāna; the verbal clause is the khabar of inna, and the nominal clause is a causation (taʿlīl).

daas-irab:59-59.t: ﴿يا﴾ a vocative particle. ﴿أَيُّهَا﴾ the one addressed (munādā); the hāʾ is for alerting (tanbīh). ﴿النَّبِيُّ﴾ badal (substitute). ﴿قُلْ﴾ the clause is resumptive. ﴿لِأَزْواجِكَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) قل. ﴿وَبَناتِكَ﴾ conjoined (maʿṭūf). ﴿وَنِساءِ﴾ conjoined. ﴿الْمُؤْمِنِينَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿يُدْنِينَ﴾ an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn because it is attached to the nūn of the feminine plural; the nūn is the fāʿil (agent). It is the response to the command (jawāb al-ṭalab), and the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿عَلَيْهِنَّ مِنْ جَلَابِيبِهِنَّ﴾ both are attached to يدنين. ﴿ذلِكَ﴾ the demonstrative, mubtadaʾ (subject); the lām is for distance and the kāf for address. ﴿أَدْنى﴾ khabar (predicate), nominative (marfūʿ) with an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the alif owing to impossibility; the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَنْ﴾ a subjunctive particle (nāṣiba). ﴿يُعْرَفْنَ﴾ a passive imperfect verb, indeclinable on the sukūn because it is attached to the nūn of the feminine plural; the nūn is the fāʿil [Translator's note: so in the source; with a passive verb it is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent)]. أن and what follows it are accusative by removal of the preposition (manṣūb bi-nazʿ al-khāfiḍ). ﴿فَلا﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction and لا is negative. ﴿يُؤْذَيْنَ﴾ its i'rab is like that of يعرفن; the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَكانَ اللَّهُ غَفُوراً رَحِيماً﴾ كان, the Divine Name is its noun, and its two predicates; the clause is conjoined.

daas-irab:60-62.t:
﴿لَئِنْ﴾ the lām is the one that prepares for the oath (al-lām al-muwaṭṭiʾa li-l-qasam), and إن is a jussive conditional particle. ﴿لَمْ﴾ a jussive particle. ﴿يَنْتَهِ الْمُنافِقُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the elision of the weak letter; المنافقون is fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ) with the wāw. ﴿وَالَّذِينَ﴾ the relative noun, conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes it. ﴿فِي قُلُوبِهِمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿مَرَضٌ﴾ postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَالْمُرْجِفُونَ﴾ conjoined to what precedes. ﴿فِي الْمَدِينَةِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb before them [Translator's note: so in the source; what precedes them is the participle المرجفون]. ﴿لَنُغْرِيَنَّكَ﴾ the lām occurs in the response to the oath, and an imperfect verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa because it is attached to the heavy nūn of emphasis; its fāʿil is latent (mustatir) and the kāf is its mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿بِهِمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb before them. ﴿ثُمَّ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿لا﴾ negative. ﴿يُجاوِرُونَكَ﴾ an imperfect verb; the wāw is its fāʿil and the kāf its mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined. ﴿فِيها﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb before them. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿قَلِيلًا﴾ a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) (nāʾib mafʿūl muṭlaq). ﴿مَلْعُونِينَ﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative (manṣūb) with the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural. ﴿أَيْنَما﴾ a jussive conditional, accusative as an adverb of place, attached to the apodosis أُخذوا. ﴿ثُقِفُوا﴾
a passive past verb; the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), and it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ). ﴿أُخِذُوا﴾ its i'rab is like that of ثقفوا; the clause is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). ﴿وَقُتِّلُوا﴾ conjoined to أخذوا. ﴿تَقْتِيلًا﴾ mafʿūl muṭlaq. ﴿سُنَّةَ﴾ mafʿūl muṭlaq of an omitted verb. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Divine Name, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فِي الَّذِينَ﴾ the relative noun is genitive; the two are attached to an omitted ḥāl. ﴿خَلَوْا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿وَلَنْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and لن is a subjunctive particle (nāṣiba). ﴿تَجِدَ لِسُنَّةِ اللَّهِ تَبْدِيلًا﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative, and its mafʿūl bihi, its fāʿil latent; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to تجد, and the Divine Name is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is conjoined.

daas-irab:63-66.t: ﴿يَسْئَلُكَ﴾ an imperfect verb, and the kāf is its mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿النَّاسُ﴾ fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive. ﴿عَنِ السَّاعَةِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb before them. ﴿قُلْ﴾ the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِنَّما﴾ restraining and restrained (kāffa wa-makfūfa). ﴿عِلْمُها﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject), and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿عِنْدَ﴾ an adverb of place, attached to the omitted khabar (predicate). ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Divine Name, muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and ما is an interrogative noun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ; the clause is conjoined. ﴿يُدْرِيكَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) with an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the yāʾ owing to heaviness; the kāf is its mafʿūl bihi and its fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the clause is the khabar of ما. ﴿لَعَلَّ السَّاعَةَ﴾ لعلّ and its noun; the clause is causal (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position. ﴿تَكُونُ قَرِيباً﴾ a defective (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb whose noun is latent, and قريبا is its khabar; the clause is the khabar of لعلّ. ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ﴾ إنّ and its noun; the clause is resumptive. ﴿لَعَنَ الْكافِرِينَ﴾ a past verb and its mafʿūl bihi; the fāʿil is latent, referring to Allah the Exalted; the clause is the khabar of إنّ. ﴿وَأَعَدَّ لَهُمْ سَعِيراً﴾ a past verb and its mafʿūl bihi, its fāʿil latent; لهم is attached to the verb; the clause is conjoined. ﴿خالِدِينَ﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative (manṣūb) with the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural. ﴿فِيها﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to خالدين. ﴿أَبَداً﴾ an adverb, attached to خالدين. ﴿لا يَجِدُونَ﴾ لا is negative, and an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is a ḥāl. ﴿وَلِيًّا﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَلا نَصِيراً﴾ conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes it. ﴿يَوْمَ﴾ an adverb of time, attached to an omitted verb, its implied form being "اذكر" (remember). ﴿تُقَلَّبُ وُجُوهُهُمْ﴾ a passive imperfect verb; وجوههم is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فِي النَّارِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to تقلّب. ﴿يَقُولُونَ﴾ the clause is resumptive. ﴿يا﴾ a particle of alerting (tanbīh). ﴿لَيْتَنا﴾ ليت and its noun; the clause is the object of the saying. ﴿أَطَعْنَا اللَّهَ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the khabar of ليتنا. ﴿وَأَطَعْنَا الرَّسُولَا﴾ conjoined to what precedes it, and its i'rab is like it.

daas-irab:67-69.t: ﴿وَقالُوا﴾ the clause is resumptive. ﴿رَبَّنا﴾ the one addressed (munādā) with an omitted vocative particle, in the position of the accusative by the vocative; نا is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿إِنَّا﴾ إنّ, and نا is its noun; the clause together with what precedes it is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿أَطَعْنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the khabar (predicate) of إنّ. ﴿سادَتَنا﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and نا is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَكُبَراءَنا﴾ conjoined (maʿṭūf) to سادتنا. ﴿فَأَضَلُّونَا السَّبِيلَا﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its two objects; the clause is conjoined. ﴿رَبَّنا﴾ the one addressed with an omitted vocative particle, accusative by the vocative; نا is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿آتِهِمْ﴾ a verb of supplication, indeclinable (mabnī) on the elision of the weak letter; the hāʾ is its first object and its fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿ضِعْفَيْنِ﴾ second mafʿūl bihi; the clause is resumptive. ﴿مِنَ الْعَذابِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted naʿt (adjective) of ضعفين. ﴿وَالْعَنْهُمْ﴾ a verb of supplication; the hāʾ is its mafʿūl bihi and its fāʿil is latent. ﴿لَعْناً﴾ mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object); the clause is conjoined. ﴿كَبِيراً﴾ naʿt of لعنا. ﴿يا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ﴾ its i'rab was given just above. ﴿آمَنُوا﴾ the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿لا﴾ prohibitive. ﴿تَكُونُوا﴾ a defective (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the elision of the nūn; the wāw is its noun. ﴿كَالَّذِينَ﴾ the kāf is a preposition and the relative noun is genitive by it; the two are attached to the omitted khabar of تكونوا. ﴿آذَوْا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿مُوسى﴾ mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb) with an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the alif owing to impossibility; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿فَبَرَّأَهُ اللَّهُ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb; the hāʾ is its mafʿūl bihi and the Divine Name its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. The Jews had claimed that Moses, peace be upon him, had leprosy, or that he had a scrotal hernia, and that this was why he did not uncover his private parts; so Allah cleared him of what they claimed, and there was no affliction in him. ﴿مِمَّا﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to برّأه. ﴿قالُوا﴾ the clause is the ṣila. ﴿وَكانَ﴾ a defective past verb whose noun is omitted. ﴿عِنْدَ﴾ an adverb of place, attached to the khabar after it. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ the Divine Name, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَجِيهاً﴾ the khabar of كان; the clause is conjoined.

daas-irab:70-73.t: ﴿يا﴾ a vocative particle. ﴿أَيُّهَا﴾ the one addressed (munādā). ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ a relative noun, badal (substitute). ﴿آمَنُوا﴾ the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿اتَّقُوا اللَّهَ﴾ an imperative verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the Divine Name is its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَقُولُوا﴾ the clause is conjoined to what precedes. ﴿قَوْلًا﴾ mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿سَدِيداً﴾ naʿt (adjective) of قولا. ﴿يُصْلِحْ لَكُمْ أَعْمالَكُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) because it is the response to the command (jawāb al-ṭalab); أعمالكم is its mafʿūl bihi and its fāʿil is latent (mustatir); لكم is attached to (mutaʿalliq) يصلح. ﴿وَيَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ ذُنُوبَكُمْ﴾ conjoined to what precedes it, and its i'rab is like it. ﴿وَمَنْ﴾ the wāw is resumptive; مَن is a jussive conditional noun, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿يُطِعِ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive because it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the fāʿil is latent. ﴿اللَّهَ﴾ the Divine Name, its mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَرَسُولَهُ﴾ conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the Divine Name. ﴿فَقَدْ﴾ the fāʾ is connective for the apodosis and قد is a particle of verification (taḥqīq). ﴿فازَ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). ﴿فَوْزاً﴾ mafʿūl muṭlaq. ﴿عَظِيماً﴾ naʿt; the two clauses of the condition are the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ. ﴿إِنَّا﴾ إنّ, and نا is its noun; the nūn of إنّ was elided for lightness; the clause is resumptive. ﴿عَرَضْنَا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar of إنّ. ﴿الْأَمانَةَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿عَلَى السَّماواتِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to عرضنا. ﴿وَالْأَرْضِ وَالْجِبالِ﴾ conjoined to what precedes. ﴿فَأَبَيْنَ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn; the nūn of the feminine plural is its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿أَنْ﴾ a subjunctive particle (nāṣiba). ﴿يَحْمِلْنَها﴾ an imperfect verb; the nūn of the feminine plural is its fāʿil and the hāʾ its mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَأَشْفَقْنَ﴾ conjoined to أبين. ﴿مِنْها﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أشفقن. ﴿وَحَمَلَهَا الْإِنْسانُ﴾ a past verb; the hāʾ is its mafʿūl bihi and الإنسان the fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿إِنَّهُ﴾ إنّ and its noun. ﴿كانَ ظَلُوماً﴾ كان and its khabar; its noun is omitted. ﴿جَهُولًا﴾ second khabar; the clause of كان is the khabar of إنه. ﴿لِيُعَذِّبَ اللَّهُ﴾ the lām is the lām of causation (lām al-taʿlīl), and an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن after the lām of causation; the Divine Name is fāʿil. ﴿الْمُنافِقِينَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi, accusative with the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural. ﴿وَالْمُنافِقاتِ﴾ conjoined. ﴿وَالْمُشْرِكِينَ وَالْمُشْرِكاتِ﴾ conjoined to what precedes them; أن and what follows it are construed as an interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun), genitive by the lām, and the two are attached to حملها. ﴿وَيَتُوبَ اللَّهُ﴾ an imperfect verb, and the Divine Name is its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿عَلَى الْمُؤْمِنِينَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يتوب. ﴿وَالْمُؤْمِناتِ﴾ conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَكانَ اللَّهُ غَفُوراً رَحِيماً﴾ كان, its noun and its two predicates; the clause is conjoined. The meaning of «الأمانة» (the trust) is the commands of the Sacred Law.

daas-irab:25-25.t: ﴿وَرَدَّ اللَّهُ الَّذِينَ﴾ The wāw is a resumptive particle, and a past verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the relative noun is its mafʿūl (object); the clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position. ﴿كَفَرُوا﴾ A past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿بِغَيْظِهِمْ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿لَمْ يَنالُوا﴾ An imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by lam, and the wāw is its fāʿil. ﴿خَيْراً﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is a second ḥāl. ﴿وَكَفَى اللَّهُ﴾ The wāw is a resumptive particle, and a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿الْمُؤْمِنِينَ﴾ First mafʿūl bihi. ﴿الْقِتالَ﴾ Its second mafʿūl; the clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position. ﴿وَكانَ اللَّهُ قَوِيًّا عَزِيزاً﴾ kāna, its ism and its two khabars (predicates); the clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position.

daas-irab:26-26.t: ﴿وَأَنْزَلَ﴾ A past verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿ظاهَرُوهُمْ﴾ A past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿مِنْ أَهْلِ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿الْكِتابِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿مِنْ صَياصِيهِمْ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb أنزل. ﴿وَقَذَفَ﴾ A past verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿فِي قُلُوبِهِمُ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿الرُّعْبَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿فَرِيقاً﴾ mafʿūl bihi placed first. ﴿تَقْتُلُونَ﴾ An imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is explicative (mufassira). ﴿وَتَأْسِرُونَ فَرِيقاً﴾ Conjoined to what precedes it.

daas-irab:27-27.t: ﴿وَأَوْرَثَكُمْ﴾ A past verb, and the kāf is the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿أَرْضَهُمْ﴾ Second mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَدِيارَهُمْ وَأَمْوالَهُمْ﴾ Both conjoined to what precedes them. ﴿وَأَرْضاً﴾ Conjoined as well. ﴿لَمْ تَطَؤُها﴾ An imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by lam, the wāw is its fāʿil, and hā is the mafʿūl bihi; the clause is an adjective (ṣifa) of أرضا. ﴿وَكانَ اللَّهُ﴾ The wāw is a resumptive particle, and a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb, and the Divine Name is its ism. ﴿عَلى كُلِّ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) ﴿قَدِيراً﴾. ﴿شَيْءٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position.

daas-irab:28-29.t: ﴿يا﴾ A vocative particle. ﴿أَيُّهَا﴾ ayy is the one addressed (munādā), an intended indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, in the position of accusative as a vocative; hā is for drawing attention (tanbīh). ﴿النَّبِيُّ﴾ badal (substitute). ﴿قُلْ﴾ The clause is resumptive. ﴿لِأَزْواجِكَ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) قل. ﴿إِنْ﴾ A particle of condition and jussive. ﴿كُنْتُنَّ﴾ A defective (nāqiṣ) past verb and its ism; the clause is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and it is initial (ibtidāʾiyya). ﴿تُرِدْنَ﴾ An imperfect verb, indeclinable on the sukūn because it is attached to the nūn of the feminine plural (nūn al-niswa), and the nūn is the fāʿil (agent); the clause is the khabar (predicate) of kāna. ﴿الْحَياةَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿الدُّنْيا﴾ An adjective (ṣifa). ﴿وَزِينَتَها﴾ Conjoined to الحياة, accusative like it, and hā is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿فَتَعالَيْنَ﴾ The fāʾ is connective for the apodosis, and an imperative verb, indeclinable on the sukūn because it is attached to the nūn of the feminine plural, and the nūn is the fāʿil; the clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). ﴿أُمَتِّعْكُنَّ﴾ An imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) because it is the answer to the request (jawāb al-ṭalab), and the kāf is its mafʿūl, and the nūn is for the feminine. ﴿وَأُسَرِّحْكُنَّ﴾ Conjoined to أمتعكن, and its i'rab is like it. ﴿سَراحاً﴾ mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿جَمِيلًا﴾ An adjective. ﴿وَإِنْ﴾ The wāw is a conjunction, and in is a jussive conditional particle. ﴿كُنْتُنَّ﴾ kāna and its ism; the clause is initial. ﴿تُرِدْنَ﴾ An imperfect verb, and the nūn of the feminine plural is its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar. ﴿اللَّهَ﴾ The Divine Name is the mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَرَسُولَهُ﴾ Conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَالدَّارَ﴾ Conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿الْآخِرَةَ﴾ An adjective. ﴿فَإِنَّ﴾ The fāʾ is connective for the apodosis, and inna is a particle resembling the verb (ḥarf mushabbah bi-l-fiʿl). ﴿اللَّهَ﴾ The Divine Name is its ism; the clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis. ﴿أَعَدَّ﴾ A past verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the clause is the khabar. ﴿لِلْمُحْسِناتِ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أعد. ﴿مِنْكُنَّ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿أَجْراً﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿عَظِيماً﴾ An adjective.

daas-irab:30-30.t: ﴿يا﴾ A vocative particle. ﴿نِساءَ﴾ The one addressed (munādā), accusative (manṣūb) because it is annexed (muḍāf). ﴿النَّبِيِّ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿مَنْ﴾ A jussive conditional noun, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿يَأْتِ﴾ An imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the weak letter; it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is the khabar (predicate). ﴿مِنْكُنَّ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿بِفاحِشَةٍ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يأت. ﴿مُبَيِّنَةٍ﴾ An adjective (ṣifa). ﴿يُضاعَفْ﴾ A passive imperfect verb, jussive because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). ﴿لَهَا﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb before them. ﴿الْعَذابُ﴾ nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). ﴿ضِعْفَيْنِ﴾ A substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (nāʾib mafʿūl muṭlaq, absolute object), accusative with the yāʾ because it is dual; the two clauses of the condition are the khabar of the mubtadaʾ من. ﴿وَكانَ﴾ The wāw is a conjunction, and a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb. ﴿ذلِكَ﴾ A demonstrative, the ism of kāna; the lām is for distance and the kāf for address. ﴿عَلَى اللَّهِ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يسيرا; the clause is conjoined. ﴿يَسِيراً﴾ khabar.

daas-irab:31-31.t: ﴿وَمَنْ﴾ The wāw is a conjunction, and man is a jussive conditional noun. ﴿يَقْنُتْ﴾ An imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya), and the two clauses of the condition are the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿مِنْكُنَّ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿لِلَّهِ﴾ The Divine Name is genitive (majrūr) by the lām, and both are attached to the verb يقنت. ﴿وَرَسُولِهِ﴾ Conjoined to what precedes it, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَتَعْمَلْ صالِحاً﴾ An imperfect verb and its mafʿūl (object), and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is conjoined. ﴿نُؤْتِها أَجْرَها﴾ An imperfect verb and its two mafʿūls, and its fāʿil is latent; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) not joined with the fāʾ. ﴿مَرَّتَيْنِ﴾ mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿وَأَعْتَدْنا﴾ The wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿لَها﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿رِزْقاً﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿كَرِيماً﴾ An adjective (ṣifa).

daas-irab:32-33.t: ﴿يا﴾ A vocative particle. ﴿نِساءَ﴾ The one addressed (munādā). ﴿النَّبِيِّ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿لَسْتُنَّ﴾ laysa is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb, the tāʾ is its ism, and the nūn is the sign of the feminine. ﴿كَأَحَدٍ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate). ﴿مِنَ النِّساءِ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of أحد. ﴿إِنِ﴾ A jussive conditional particle. ﴿اتَّقَيْتُنَّ﴾ A past verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the nūn is the sign of the feminine plural; the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya) because it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ). ﴿فَلا﴾ The fāʾ is connective for the apodosis, and lā is prohibitive. ﴿تَخْضَعْنَ﴾ An imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn because it is attached to the nūn of the feminine plural (nūn al-niswa), and the nūn is the fāʿil; the clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). ﴿بِالْقَوْلِ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb before them. ﴿فَيَطْمَعَ﴾ The fāʾ is the fāʾ of causation (fāʾ al-sababiyya), and an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied (muḍmara) an after the fāʾ of causation. ﴿الَّذِي﴾ fāʿil. ﴿فِي قَلْبِهِ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a khabar placed first. ﴿مَرَضٌ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject) placed after; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَقُلْنَ﴾ An imperative verb, indeclinable on the sukūn, and the nūn of the feminine plural is the fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿قَوْلًا﴾ mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿مَعْرُوفاً﴾ An adjective of قولا. ﴿وَقَرْنَ﴾ The wāw is a conjunction, and an imperative verb, indeclinable on the sukūn because it is attached to the nūn of the feminine plural, and the nūn is the fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿فِي بُيُوتِكُنَّ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to قرن. ﴿وَلا﴾ The wāw is a conjunction and lā is prohibitive. ﴿تَبَرَّجْنَ تَبَرُّجَ﴾ An imperfect verb, and the nūn of the feminine plural is its fāʿil, and تبرج is a mafʿūl muṭlaq. ﴿الْجاهِلِيَّةِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿الْأُولى﴾ An adjective, genitive (majrūr) by the kasra implied (muqaddar) on the alif because of impossibility (taʿadhdhur). ﴿وَأَقِمْنَ﴾ Its i'rab is like وقرن. ﴿الصَّلاةَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿وَآتِينَ﴾ Conjoined. ﴿الزَّكاةَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَأَطِعْنَ اللَّهَ﴾ Its i'rab is like the preceding one. ﴿وَرَسُولَهُ﴾ Conjoined. ﴿إِنَّما﴾ The restraining [mā] and the restrained [inna] (kāffa makfūfa). ﴿يُرِيدُ اللَّهُ﴾ An imperfect verb, and the Divine Name is its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿لِيُذْهِبَ﴾ The lām is the lām of causation, and an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied an after the lām of causation; the lām and what follows it, being interpretable as a maṣdar (verbal noun), are attached to يريد. ﴿عَنْكُمُ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يذهب. ﴿الرِّجْسَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿أَهْلَ﴾ Accusative by specialization (ikhtiṣāṣ), its implied form being "I specify (akhuṣṣu) the people of". ﴿الْبَيْتِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَيُطَهِّرَكُمْ﴾ The clause is conjoined. ﴿تَطْهِيراً﴾ mafʿūl muṭlaq.

daas-irab:34-35.t: ﴿وَاذْكُرْنَ﴾ The wāw is a conjunction, and an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, and the nūn of the feminine plural (nūn al-niswa) is the fāʿil (agent); the clause is conjoined. ﴿ما﴾ A relative [mā], mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿يُتْلى﴾ A passive imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the alif because of impossibility (taʿadhdhur), and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿فِي بُيُوتِكُنَّ﴾ The preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) يتلى, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿مِنْ آياتِ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ The Divine Name is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَالْحِكْمَةِ﴾ Conjoined to what came before. ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ﴾ inna, and the Divine Name is its ism. ﴿كانَ لَطِيفاً خَبِيراً﴾ kāna and its two khabars (predicates), and its ism is omitted; the clause is the khabar of inna. ﴿إِنَّ الْمُسْلِمِينَ﴾ inna and its ism, accusative (manṣūb) with the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural; the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَالْمُسْلِماتِ﴾ Conjoined. ﴿وَالْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِناتِ وَالْقانِتِينَ وَالْقانِتاتِ وَالصَّادِقِينَ وَالصَّادِقاتِ وَالصَّابِرِينَ وَالصَّابِراتِ وَالْخاشِعِينَ وَالْخاشِعاتِ وَالْمُتَصَدِّقِينَ وَالْمُتَصَدِّقاتِ وَالصَّائِمِينَ وَالصَّائِماتِ وَالْحافِظِينَ﴾ All these nouns are conjoined to what precedes them. ﴿فُرُوجَهُمْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi of الحافظين. ﴿وَالْحافِظاتِ﴾ Conjoined, accusative by the kasra in place of the fatḥa because it is a sound feminine plural. ﴿وَالذَّاكِرِينَ﴾ Conjoined. ﴿اللَّهَ﴾ The Divine Name is the mafʿūl bihi of الذاكرين. ﴿كَثِيراً﴾ An adjective (ṣifa) of a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿وَالذَّاكِراتِ﴾ Conjoined. ﴿أَعَدَّ اللَّهُ﴾ A past verb, and the Divine Name is its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar of inna. ﴿لَهُمْ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أعد. ﴿مَغْفِرَةً﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَأَجْراً﴾ Conjoined. ﴿عَظِيماً﴾ An adjective.

daas-irab:36-37.t: ﴿وَما﴾ The wāw is resumptive and mā is negating. ﴿كانَ﴾ A defective (nāqiṣ) past verb. ﴿لِمُؤْمِنٍ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) placed first. ﴿وَلا﴾ The wāw is a conjunction and lā is negating. ﴿مُؤْمِنَةٍ﴾ Conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿إِذا﴾ An adverb containing the sense of condition. ﴿قَضَى اللَّهُ﴾ A past verb, and the Divine Name is its fāʿil (agent). ﴿وَرَسُولُهُ﴾ Conjoined. ﴿أَمْراً﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿أَنْ﴾ Making the verb accusative (nāṣiba). ﴿يَكُونَ﴾ A defective imperfect verb. ﴿لَهُمُ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar. ﴿الْخِيَرَةُ﴾ The ism of يكون. ﴿مِنْ أَمْرِهِمْ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَمَنْ﴾ The wāw is a conjunction and man is conditional. ﴿يَعْصِ﴾ An imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the weak letter, and it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ). ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ The Divine Name is the mafʿūl bihi. [Translator's note: the source vocalizes the word here as اللَّهُ; in the verse it is اللَّهَ, accusative, as the analysis states.] ﴿وَرَسُولُهُ﴾ Conjoined. ﴿فَقَدْ﴾ The fāʾ is connective for the apodosis, and qad is a particle of verification (taḥqīq). ﴿ضَلَّ ضَلالًا﴾ A past verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir), and a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿مُبِيناً﴾ An adjective (ṣifa) of ضلالا; the clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). ﴿وَإِذْ﴾ The wāw is a conjunction, and iḏ is an adverb attached to the omitted verb, its implied form being "remember (udhkur)". ﴿تَقُولُ﴾ An imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿لِلَّذِي﴾ The relative noun is genitive (majrūr) by the lām, and both are attached to تقول. ﴿أَنْعَمَ اللَّهُ﴾ A past verb, and the Divine Name is its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿عَلَيْهِ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أنعم. ﴿وَأَنْعَمْتَ﴾ Conjoined. ﴿عَلَيْهِ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿أَمْسِكْ عَلَيْكَ زَوْجَكَ﴾ An imperative verb and its mafʿūl, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to أمسك; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿وَاتَّقِ اللَّهَ﴾ An imperative verb, and the Divine Name is its mafʿūl; the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَتُخْفِي﴾ An imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the yāʾ because of heaviness (thiqal), and the fāʿil is latent. ﴿فِي نَفْسِكَ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to تخفي; the clause is conjoined. ﴿مَا﴾ The relative noun is the mafʿūl bihi. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ The Divine Name is a mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿مُبْدِيهِ﴾ khabar, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿وَتَخْشَى النَّاسَ﴾ The wāw is a conjunction, and an imperfect verb, nominative by the ḍamma implied on the alif because of impossibility (taʿadhdhur), and its fāʿil is latent, and الناس is the mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَاللَّهُ أَحَقُّ﴾ The Divine Name is a mubtadaʾ and أحق is the khabar; the clause is circumstantial (ḥāliyya). ﴿أَنْ﴾ Making the verb accusative. ﴿تَخْشاهُ﴾ An imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by the fatḥa implied on the alif because of impossibility, and hā is its mafʿūl, and its fāʿil is latent; an and what follows it are interpretable as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the genitive, i.e. "[more worthy] of being feared (bi-l-khashya)", and both are attached to أحق. ﴿فَلَمَّا﴾ The fāʾ is resumptive and lammā is an adverb of time. ﴿قَضى زَيْدٌ﴾ A past verb and its fāʿil; Zayd is Ibn Ḥāritha. ﴿مِنْها﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to قضى. ﴿وَطَراً﴾ mafʿūl bihi; the clause is resumptive. ﴿زَوَّجْناكَها﴾ A past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the answer of lammā. ﴿لِكَيْ لا﴾ The lām is a preposition of causation, kay makes the verb accusative, and lā is negating. ﴿يَكُونَ﴾ A defective imperfect verb, accusative; the interpreted maṣdar formed from kay and what follows it is genitive by the lām, and both are attached to the verb before them. ﴿عَلَى الْمُؤْمِنِينَ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar placed first. ﴿حَرَجٌ﴾ The ism of يكون. ﴿فِي أَزْواجِ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective of حرج. ﴿أَدْعِيائِهِمْ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿إِذا﴾ An adverb containing the sense of condition. ﴿قَضَوْا﴾ A past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿مِنْهُنَّ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to قضوا. ﴿وَطَراً﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَكانَ أَمْرُ اللَّهِ مَفْعُولًا﴾ kāna, and أمر is its ism, the Divine Name is muḍāf ilayhi, and مفعولا is the khabar; the clause is conjoined.

daas-irab:38-39.t: ﴿ما﴾ negating. ﴿كانَ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ﴾ kāna, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) placed first. ﴿مِنْ﴾ A redundant (zāʾida) preposition. ﴿حَرَجٍ﴾ A noun genitive (majrūr) in form, nominative (marfūʿ) in position, the ism of kāna; the clause is resumptive. ﴿فِيما﴾ mā is relative (mawṣūliyya), and both are attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of حرج. ﴿فَرَضَ اللَّهُ﴾ A past verb, and the Divine Name is its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿لَهُ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to فرض. ﴿سُنَّةَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ The Divine Name is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). [Translator's note: the source vocalizes the word here as اللَّهُ; in the verse it is اللَّهِ, genitive, as the analysis states.] ﴿فِي﴾ A preposition. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ A relative noun; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿خَلَوْا﴾ A past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿مِنْ قَبْلُ﴾ قبل is an adverb of time, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma because it is cut off from annexation; both are attached to the verb before them. ﴿وَكانَ أَمْرُ اللَّهِ قَدَراً﴾ kāna, its ism and its khabar, and the Divine Name is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿مَقْدُوراً﴾ An adjective; the clause is conjoined. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ The relative noun is the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being "they (hum)". ﴿يُبَلِّغُونَ رِسالاتِ﴾ An imperfect verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl, accusative (manṣūb) by the kasra in place of the fatḥa because it is a sound feminine plural. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ The Divine Name is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَيَخْشَوْنَهُ﴾ An imperfect verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl. ﴿وَلا يَخْشَوْنَ﴾ The clause is conjoined. ﴿وَلا﴾ The wāw is a conjunction, lā is negating. ﴿يَخْشَوْنَ أَحَداً﴾ An imperfect verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ A particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ The Divine Name is a badal (substitute) for the mafʿūl bihi. [Translator's note: the source vocalizes the word here as اللَّهِ; in the verse it is اللَّهَ.] ﴿وَكَفى بِاللَّهِ﴾ The wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb; and in بالله the bāʾ is a redundant preposition and the Divine Name is the fāʿil. ﴿حَسِيباً﴾ tamyīz (specification); the clause is conjoined.

daas-irab:40-42.t: ﴿ما﴾ negating. ﴿كانَ مُحَمَّدٌ﴾ kāna, and the word محمد ﷺ is the ism of kāna; the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَبا﴾ khabar (predicate), accusative (manṣūb) with the alif because it is one of the five nouns (al-asmāʾ al-khamsa). ﴿أَحَدٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿مِنْ رِجالِكُمْ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of أحد. ﴿وَلكِنْ﴾ The wāw is a conjunction, and lākin is a particle of rectification (istidrāk). ﴿رَسُولَ﴾ Conjoined to أبا, accusative like it. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ The Divine Name is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَخاتَمَ﴾ Conjoined to what came before. ﴿النَّبِيِّينَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr) with the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural. ﴿وَكانَ اللَّهُ﴾ kāna, and the Divine Name is its ism; the clause is conjoined. ﴿بِكُلِّ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to عليما. ﴿شَيْءٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿عَلِيماً﴾ khabar; the clause is conjoined. خاتم, in the reading with fatḥa on the tāʾ, means the instrument of sealing, i.e. the prophets were sealed with him; and there is a reading with kasra on the tāʾ, i.e. there will never be a prophet after him; he is the last of them, upon him be peace. ﴿يا﴾ A vocative particle. ﴿أَيُّهَا﴾ The one addressed (munādā), an intended indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, and hā is for drawing attention (tanbīh); the clause is resumptive. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ A relative noun, badal (substitute). ﴿آمَنُوا﴾ A past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿اذْكُرُوا اللَّهَ﴾ An imperative verb and its fāʿil, and the Divine Name is its mafʿūl (object). ﴿ذِكْراً﴾ mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿كَثِيراً﴾ An adjective; the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَسَبِّحُوهُ﴾ Conjoined to what came before. ﴿بُكْرَةً﴾ An adverb of time, attached to the verb before it. ﴿وَأَصِيلًا﴾ Conjoined to what precedes it. البكرة is the beginning of the day and الأصيل its end.

daas-irab:43-46.t: ﴿هُوَ﴾ A detached pronoun, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿الَّذِي﴾ khabar (predicate); the clause is resumptive. ﴿يُصَلِّي﴾ An imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the yāʾ because of heaviness (thiqal), and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿عَلَيْكُمْ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) يصلي. ﴿وَمَلائِكَتُهُ﴾ Conjoined to what came before. ﴿لِيُخْرِجَكُمْ﴾ The lām is the lām of causation, and the imperfect verb is accusative (manṣūb) by the implied (muḍmara) an after the lām of causation; its fāʿil is latent, and the kāf is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿مِنَ الظُّلُماتِ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿إِلَى النُّورِ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb as well. ﴿وَكانَ﴾ kāna; the clause is conjoined. ﴿بِالْمُؤْمِنِينَ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the khabar of kāna, placed after. ﴿رَحِيماً﴾ khabar. ﴿تَحِيَّتُهُمْ﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿يَوْمَ﴾ An adverb of time; the clause is resumptive. ﴿يَلْقَوْنَهُ﴾ An imperfect verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl; the clause is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿سَلامٌ﴾ khabar. ﴿وَأَعَدَّ لَهُمْ أَجْراً﴾ A past verb and its mafʿūl, and its fāʿil is latent, and لهم is attached to the verb before them. ﴿كَرِيماً﴾ An adjective (ṣifa) of أجرا; the clause is conjoined. ﴿يا﴾ A vocative particle. ﴿أَيُّهَا﴾ The one addressed (munādā), whose i'rab was given shortly before; the clause is resumptive. ﴿النَّبِيُّ﴾ badal (substitute). ﴿إِنَّا﴾ inna, and nā is its ism. ﴿أَرْسَلْناكَ﴾ A past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl; the clause is the khabar of inna. ﴿شاهِداً﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative. ﴿وَمُبَشِّراً وَنَذِيراً وَداعِياً﴾ These words are conjoined to what precedes them. ﴿إِلَى اللَّهِ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to داعيا. ﴿بِإِذْنِهِ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to داعيا. ﴿وَسِراجاً﴾ Conjoined to what came before. ﴿مُنِيراً﴾ An adjective of سراجا.
