daas-irab:47-48.t: ﴿وَبَشِّرِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ﴾ An imperative verb and its mafʿūl (object), and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is resumptive. ﴿بِأَنَّ﴾ The bāʾ is a preposition and anna is a particle resembling the verb (ḥarf mushabbah bi-l-fiʿl); anna and what follows it are in the position of genitive by the bāʾ, and both are attached to (mutaʿalliq) بشر. ﴿لَهُمْ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar (predicate) of anna. ﴿مِنَ اللَّهِ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿فَضْلًا﴾ The ism of anna, placed after. ﴿كَبِيراً﴾ An adjective (ṣifa) of فضلا. ﴿وَلا﴾ lā is prohibitive. ﴿تُطِعِ﴾ An imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by lā, and the fāʿil is latent. ﴿الْكافِرِينَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb) with the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural. ﴿وَالْمُنافِقِينَ﴾ Conjoined to what came before. ﴿وَدَعْ أَذاهُمْ﴾ An imperative verb and its mafʿūl, and the fāʿil is latent; the two clauses are conjoined. ﴿وَتَوَكَّلْ﴾ An imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is conjoined. ﴿عَلَى اللَّهِ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to توكل. ﴿وَكَفى﴾ A past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif because of impossibility (taʿadhdhur). ﴿بِاللَّهِ﴾ The bāʾ is a redundant (zāʾida) preposition, and the Divine Name is the fāʿil. ﴿وَكِيلًا﴾ tamyīz (specification); the clause is conjoined.

daas-irab:49-50.t: ﴿يا﴾ A vocative particle. ﴿أَيُّهَا﴾ The one addressed (munādā), whose i'rab was given shortly before. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ badal (substitute) or ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition). ﴿آمَنُوا﴾ A past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿إِذا﴾ An adverb of time containing the sense of condition. ﴿نَكَحْتُمُ الْمُؤْمِناتِ﴾ A past verb and its fāʿil, and المؤمنات is its mafʿūl (object); the clause is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿ثُمَّ﴾ A conjunction. ﴿طَلَّقْتُمُوهُنَّ﴾ A past verb; the tāʾ is its fāʿil, the wāw is for lengthening (ishbāʿ), and the hāʾ is its mafʿūl; the clause is conjoined. ﴿مِنْ قَبْلِ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) طلقتموهن. ﴿أَنْ﴾ an, making the verb accusative (nāṣiba). ﴿تَمَسُّوهُنَّ﴾ An imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an, the sign of its accusative being the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is its fāʿil, the hāʾ its mafʿūl, and the nūn the sign of the feminine plural; an and what follows it are interpretable as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi of the adverb. The meaning of تمسوهن is "have intercourse with them". ﴿فَما﴾ The fāʾ is connective for the apodosis and mā is negating. ﴿لَكُمْ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar (predicate) placed first. ﴿عَلَيْهِنَّ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿مِنْ﴾ redundant (zāʾida). ﴿عِدَّةٍ﴾ A noun genitive (majrūr) in form, nominative (marfūʿ) in position, the mubtadaʾ (subject) placed after. ﴿تَعْتَدُّونَها﴾ An imperfect verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl; the clause is an adjective (ṣifa) of عدة. ﴿فَمَتِّعُوهُنَّ﴾ The fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa, and an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is its fāʿil, the hāʾ its mafʿūl, and the nūn the sign of the feminine plural. ﴿وَسَرِّحُوهُنَّ﴾ Conjoined to متعوهن. ﴿سَراحاً﴾ mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿جَمِيلًا﴾ An adjective. ﴿يا أَيُّهَا﴾ Its i'rab was given shortly before. ﴿النَّبِيُّ﴾ badal. ﴿إِنَّا﴾ inna and its ism; the nūn of inna was dropped for lightening. ﴿أَحْلَلْنا﴾ A past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar. ﴿لَكَ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أحللنا. ﴿أَزْواجَكَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿اللَّاتِي﴾ A relative noun in the position of accusative, an adjective of أزواجك. ﴿آتَيْتَ﴾ A past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿أُجُورَهُنَّ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَما﴾ The wāw is a conjunction and mā is a relative noun. ﴿مَلَكَتْ يَمِينُكَ﴾ A past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila, and the clause ما ملكت is conjoined. ﴿مِمَّا﴾ min is a preposition and mā is relative (mawṣūliyya); both are attached to an omitted ḥāl. ﴿أَفاءَ اللَّهُ﴾ A past verb, and the Divine Name is its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿عَلَيْكَ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أفاء. ﴿وَبَناتِ﴾ Conjoined to أزواجك. ﴿عَمِّكَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَبَناتِ عَمَّاتِكَ﴾ Conjoined to what came before. ﴿وَبَناتِ خالِكَ وَبَناتِ خالاتِكَ﴾ Conjoined to what came before. ﴿اللَّاتِي﴾ A relative noun, adjective. ﴿هاجَرْنَ﴾ A past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn because it is attached to the nūn of the feminine plural (nūn al-niswa), and the nūn is the fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿مَعَكَ﴾ An adverb attached to هاجرن. ﴿وَامْرَأَةً﴾ Conjoined to أزواجك, and it is the mafʿūl of أحللنا. ﴿مُؤْمِنَةً﴾ An adjective of امرأة. ﴿إِنْ﴾ A jussive conditional particle. ﴿وَهَبَتْ﴾ A past verb; the tāʾ is for the feminine and the fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿نَفْسَها﴾ mafʿūl bihi, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لِلنَّبِيِّ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to وهبت; the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is implied (muqaddar). ﴿إِنْ﴾ conditional. ﴿أَرادَ النَّبِيُّ﴾ A past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya). ﴿إِنْ﴾ [Translator's note: so in the source; the word of the verse is أَنْ, which the analysis describes.] Making the verb accusative (nāṣiba). ﴿يَسْتَنْكِحَها﴾ An imperfect verb, accusative, and its mafʿūl, and the fāʿil is latent; the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of accusative as the mafʿūl of أراد. ﴿خالِصَةً﴾ ḥāl, accusative. ﴿لَكَ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to خالصة. ﴿مِنْ دُونِ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl. ﴿الْمُؤْمِنِينَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿قَدْ﴾ A particle of verification (taḥqīq). ﴿عَلِمْنا﴾ A past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿ما﴾ A relative noun in the position of accusative as the mafʿūl bihi of علمنا. ﴿فَرَضْنا﴾ A past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿عَلَيْهِمْ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb before them. ﴿فِي أَزْواجِهِمْ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to فرضنا. ﴿وَما﴾ Conjoined to أزواجهم. ﴿مَلَكَتْ أَيْمانُهُمْ﴾ A past verb and its fāʿil; the tāʾ is for the feminine and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila of the relative noun. ﴿لِكَيْلا﴾ The lām is a preposition, kay makes the verb accusative, and lā is negating; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to أحللنا. ﴿يَكُونَ﴾ A defective (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb. ﴿عَلَيْكَ﴾ A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar of يكون. ﴿حَرَجٌ﴾ The ism of يكون. ﴿وَكانَ اللَّهُ غَفُوراً رَحِيماً﴾ kāna, its ism and its two khabars; the clause is conjoined.
